ownerApproval.scope: Implement and execute the fixed one-run adaptation experiment, including conditional reserved evaluation

scope: Local Python completion research; last two encoder layers plus existing linear head; no product integration or student

architecture.frozenModules: embeddings, encoder.layer.0 through .9, pooler; no new architecture
architecture.pooling: attention-mask mean over last hidden states, including unmasked special tokens, matching the published example
architecture.headInitialization: Cast frozen sms_completion_encoder_v1_candidate weights/bias to float32; no random head restart
architecture.mode: All modules eval() throughout training and inference; gradients enabled only for final two layers and head. Dropout disabled.

inputs.padding: longest in batch; published tokenizer unchanged
inputs.preflightOverflow: Stop before training; no dropping/truncation/limit change

cohort.trainingViewEncoding: Original encoder prepare() ordered training view, then scope JSONL proposed_training rows with target!=uncertain; keys recordId,text,target,weight,group. New group=authoringGroupId, new weight=1/6. JSON ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'), UTF-8,no newline.
cohort.priorGroupWeighting: Preserve all original row weights; each old/new authoring group totals one
cohort.researchViewAdmission: Only this explicit protocol when approved may select weak training rows. Dataset canonical admission/modelFittingAllowed flags remain false.
cohort.evidenceSpans: Review/audit only; never model input or auxiliary training targets
cohort.validationUsage: No gradient, feature fitting, batch selection, scheduler, stopping or checkpoint selection

training.shuffle: New torch.randperm(N) each epoch using one dedicated CPU Generator seeded once; both languages remain in fixed data folds, can be separate minibatches
training.decayScope: All trainable weights and biases including LayerNorm; frozen parameters excluded
training.loss: BCEWithLogits(reduction=none); minibatch loss=N/(W*b)*sum_i(weight_i*loss_i), N=1158,W=129,b=actual minibatch size; no pos_weight
training.checkpointSelection: Final state after exactly three full epochs only; no best-development checkpoint
training.decision: completed iff signed logit > 0; tie non_transaction; no calibration or confidence percentage
training.determinism: Seed Python/NumPy/Torch; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); record environment. Error if unsupported deterministic operation.

budget.wallClockBoundary: Parent watchdog starts before first training forward; kills worker at deadline, no resume or partial candidate evaluation
budget.memoryEnforcement: Supervisor samples Windows process working set once per second; stops on breach. This is a monitored limit, not a hard instantaneous OS reservation.
budget.onFailure: Retain immutable attempt/failure details; no restart, smaller batch, extra epoch, alternate seed/device/model or automatic new run

preflight: Verify all frozen file hashes, old immutable trial ledger and pinned base weight checksum; reproduce scope data check
Reconstruct training view hash/counts/groups; assert no scope dev/reserved or uncertain IDs in training
Check all token lengths without encoder inference or truncation, including reserved token lengths only
Assert trainable parameter names/counts exactly; optimizer has only those tensors; clone/hash frozen tensors for post-run check

Before first optimizer step verify copied float32 head agrees with existing frozen score within 2e-5 with identical decisions on old exposed diagnostics; stop on discrepancy, never adjust labels/boundary
Write exclusive immutable start ledger with protocol/producer/environment/batch order and initial weights before first training forward. Preserve failure ledger on any error

evaluation.separateControls: 14 quote controls (10 definite), flag two duplicate manual texts
metrics: case fixes/regressions with IDs; theme and matched-state consistency
uncertain outputs separately with no forced binary truth
actual elapsed time, peak sampled working set, checkpoint bytes, warm CPU inference timings

preReservedGate.falseCompleted: Zero per definite primary cohort/language and quote controls
preReservedGate.missedCompleted: No more misses than the best of the three fixed references per primary cohort/language; quote controls no more than best reference
preReservedGate.criticalRegressions: No new OTP/declined/ordinary-chat/example false acceptance; list all case swaps
preReservedGate.ifFailed: Record failed run. Do not infer reserved rows, fit student or tune anything.

evaluation.reservedAccess: Only if all pre-reserved gates pass: score all three unchanged references and final candidate once on reserved fold. No adjustment after observation.
evaluation.reservedGate: Zero FP and no more FN than best fixed reference on definite reserved rows, per language and overall; uncertain separate
evaluation.candidateCachePolicy: Only final candidate and references on listed folds; no intermediate validation/inference for checkpoint selection
evaluation.independence: All authored/weak; old diagnostic exposure and semantic theme overlap remain. No real-world accuracy or release claim.

outputs.checkpoint: Ignored local safetensors of final two encoder layers and head, with pinned base hash and exact replacement tensor names; not standalone or TypeScript model
outputs.audit: Immutable attempt/failure/report plus trainable/frozen tensor hashes and exact head binding
